<?php
// E2E probe (test only): creates saved-method tokens and orders, short-circuits gateway HTTP (counting calls).
add_filter( 'pre_http_request', function ( $pre, $args, $url ) {
	if ( false === strpos( (string) $url, 'transactiongateway' ) ) { return $pre; }
	update_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_http_count', (int) get_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_http_count', 0 ) + 1 );
	return array( 'headers' => array(), 'body' => 'response=1&responsetext=SUCCESS&transactionid=CAP1&authcode=A1', 'response' => array( 'code' => 200, 'message' => 'OK' ), 'cookies' => array(), 'filename' => null );
}, 10, 3 );
add_action( 'wp_loaded', function () {
	if ( empty( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) ) { return; }
	$mode = sanitize_key( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] );
	header( 'Content-Type: application/json' );
	$gid  = 'cardz3n_gateway';
	$tok  = function ( $user, $gateway, $value ) {
		$t = new WC_Payment_Token_CC();
		$t->set_token( $value ); $t->set_gateway_id( $gateway ); $t->set_user_id( $user );
		$t->set_card_type( 'visa' ); $t->set_last4( '1111' ); $t->set_expiry_month( '12' ); $t->set_expiry_year( '2030' );
		$t->save();
		return $t->get_id();
	};
	if ( 'nonce' === $mode ) {
		echo wp_json_encode( array( 'nonce' => wp_create_nonce( 'cardz3n_gw_nonce' ), 'logged_in' => is_user_logged_in() ) );
		exit;
	}
	if ( 'tokens' === $mode ) {
		if ( ! current_user_can( 'manage_woocommerce' ) ) { echo wp_json_encode( array( 'error' => 'login' ) ); exit; }
		$other_user = wp_insert_user( array( 'user_login' => 'e2e-other-' . wp_rand( 100, 999 ), 'user_pass' => wp_generate_password(), 'user_email' => 'e2e' . wp_rand( 100, 999 ) . '@example.test' ) );
		echo wp_json_encode( array(
			'nonce'      => wp_create_nonce( 'cardz3n_gw_nonce' ),
			'own'        => $tok( get_current_user_id(), $gid, 'VAULT-OWN' ),
			'own_other'  => $tok( get_current_user_id(), 'some_other_gateway', 'VAULT-OTHER-GATEWAY' ),
			'other_user' => $tok( $other_user, $gid, 'VAULT-OTHER-USER' ),
			'guest'      => $tok( 0, $gid, 'VAULT-GUEST' ),
		) );
		exit;
	}
	if ( 'exists' === $mode ) {
		$ids = array_map( 'absint', explode( ',', isset( $_GET['ids'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_GET['ids'] ) ) : '' ) );
		$out = array();
		foreach ( $ids as $id ) { $out[ $id ] = (bool) WC_Payment_Tokens::get( $id ); }
		echo wp_json_encode( $out );
		exit;
	}
	if ( 'pay' === $mode ) {
		$state = isset( $_GET['state'] ) ? sanitize_key( $_GET['state'] ) : 'pending';
		if ( function_exists( 'wc_load_cart' ) && null === WC()->session ) { wc_load_cart(); }
		$o = wc_create_order();
		$o->set_payment_method( $gid );
		$o->set_total( '5.00' );
		$o->set_billing_email( 'e2e@example.test' );
		if ( 'paid' === $state ) { $o->set_status( 'processing' ); $o->set_date_paid( time() ); }
		if ( 'authorized' === $state ) { $o->set_status( 'on-hold' ); $o->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_authorized_amount', '5.00' ); $o->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_transaction_id', 'T-AUTH' ); }
		$o->save();
		$_POST = array( 'cardz3n_payment_token' => 'tok-e2e', 'cardz3n_token_type' => 'card', 'cardz3n_payment_source' => 'card' );
		$before = (int) get_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_http_count', 0 );
		$gw = WC()->payment_gateways()->payment_gateways()[ $gid ];
		$r  = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		echo wp_json_encode( array( 'result' => is_array( $r ) ? $r['result'] : 'none', 'http_calls' => (int) get_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_http_count', 0 ) - $before ) );
		exit;
	}
	exit;
}, 20 );
